rationale: check_latex matches the exact overline control word unless extended by ASCII letters, checks an immediately preceding opening brace and exactly one literal following ASCII space, and counts source newlines for diagnostics. The negative cases include tabs/newlines/CRLF/nonbreaking-space, missing braces and command endings; positive cases include nested groups and longer command names. process checks raw chapter text, while all_book_markdown_follows_latex_conventions recursively scans Markdown under md independently of SUMMARY. The claim correctly calls this an adjacency check rather than brace balancing or TeX parsing.
limitations: Literal samples are intentionally linted too; successful lint does not establish valid TeX beyond these adjacent characters.
